flora: Colonies of floating water lilies (covering large patches of the lake surface)
Ancient ginkgo trees (in the misty background)
environment_details.style_notes: STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3; rounded toy-like proportions; serene and peaceful mood; emphasizing the plant's floating nature; no sharp or aggressive geometry; soft volcanic color palette.

visual_logic.composition: A wide-angle view of a calm, clear volcanic lake. Patches of water lilies form a green 'carpet' across the water. The surrounding shore consists of light ash grey tuff cliffs and soft buff-colored rocks.
visual_logic.ground: The bottom of the shallow lake is visible through clear water, showing light grey ash and silt.
visual_logic.lighting: Soft morning sunlight with a hazy atmospheric depth over the water, creating a calm and inviting educational scene.
